passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.1
passages.text: Formosum pastor Corydon ardebat Alexim,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.2
passages.text: delicias domini, nec quid speraret habebat;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.3
passages.text: tantum inter densas, umbrosa cacumina, fagos

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.4
passages.text: adsidue veniebat. Ibi haec incondita solus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.5
passages.text: montibus et silvis studio iactabat inani:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.6
passages.text: O crudelis Alexi, nihil mea carmina curas?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.7
passages.text: Nil nostri miserere? Mori me denique coges.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.8
passages.text: nunc etiam pecudes umbras et frigora captant;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.9
passages.text: nunc viridis etiam occultant spineta lacertos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.10
passages.text: Thestylis et rapido fessis messoribus aestu

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.11
passages.text: alia serpyllumque herbas contundit olentis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.12
passages.text: at mecum raucis, tua dum vestigia lustro,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.13
passages.text: sole sub ardenti resonant arbusta cicadis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.14
passages.text: Nonne fuit satius tristis Amaryllidis iras

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.15
passages.text: atque superba pati fastidia, nonne Menalcan,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.16
passages.text: quam vis ille niger, quamvis tu candidus esses ?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.17
passages.text: o formose puer, nimium ne crede colori!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.18
passages.text: alba ligustra cadunt, vaccinia nigra leguntur.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.19
passages.text: Despectus tibi sum, nec qui sim quaeris, Alexi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.20
passages.text: quam dives pecoris, nivei quam lactis abundans.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.21
passages.text: mille meae Siculis errant in montibus agnae;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.22
passages.text: lac mihi non aestate novum, non frigore defit;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.23
passages.text: canto quae solitus, si quando armenta vocabat,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.24
passages.text: Amphion Dircaeus in Actaeo Aracimtho.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.25
passages.text: Nec sum adeo informis: nuper me in litore vidi,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.26
passages.text: cum placidum ventis staret mare; non ego Daphnim

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.27
passages.text: iudice te metuam, si numquam fallit imago.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.28
passages.text: O tantum libeat mecum tibi sordida rura

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.29
passages.text: atque humilis habitare casas, et figere cervos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.30
passages.text: haedorumque gregem viridi compellere hibisco!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.31
passages.text: Mecum una in silvis imitabere Pana canendo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.32
passages.text: Pan primus calamos cera coniungere pluris

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.33
passages.text: instituit; Pan curat ovis oviumque magistros.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.34
passages.text: Nec te paeniteat calamo trivisse labellum:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.35
passages.text: haec eadem ut sciret, quid non faciebat Amyntas?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.36
passages.text: est mihi disparibus septem compacta cicutis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.37
passages.text: fistula, Damoetas dono mihi quam dedit olim,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.38
passages.text: et dixit moriens: “Te nunc habet ista secundum.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.39
passages.text: dixit Damoetas, invidit stultus Amyntas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.40
passages.text: Praeterea duo, nec tuta mihi valle reperti,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.41
passages.text: capreoli, sparsis etiam nunc pellibus albo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.42
passages.text: bina die siccant ovis ubera; quos tibi servo:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.43
passages.text: iam pridem a me illos abducere Thestylis orat;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.44
passages.text: et faciet, quoniam sordent tibi munera nostra.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.45
passages.text: Huc ades, O formose puer: tibi lilia plenis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.46
passages.text: ecce ferunt Nymphae calathis; tibi candida Nais,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.47
passages.text: pallentis violas et summa papavera carpens,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.48
passages.text: narcissum et florem iungit bene olentis anethi;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.49
passages.text: tum casia atque aliis intexens suavibus herbis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.50
passages.text: mollia luteola pingit vaccinia calta.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.51
passages.text: Ipse ego cana legam tenera lanugine mala,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.52
passages.text: castaneasque nuces, mea quas Amaryllis amabat;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.53
passages.text: addam cerea pruna: honos erit huic quoque pomo;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.54
passages.text: et vos, O lauri, carpam, et te, proxima myrte,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.55
passages.text: sic positae quoniam suavis miscetis odores.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.56
passages.text: Rusticus es, Corydon: nec munera curat Alexis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.57
passages.text: nec, si muneribus certes, concedat Iollas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.58
passages.text: Heu, heu, quid volui misero mihi! Floribus austrum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.59
passages.text: perditus et liquidis inmisi fontibus apros.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.60
passages.text: Quem fugis, ah, demens? Habitarunt di quoque silvas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.61
passages.text: Dardaniusque Paris. Pallas, quas condidit arces,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.62
passages.text: ipsa colat; nobis placeant ante omnia silvae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.63
passages.text: Torva leaena lupum sequitur; lupus ipse capellam;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.64
passages.text: florentem cytisum sequitur lasciva capella;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.65
passages.text: te Corydon, o Alexi: trahit sua quemque voluptas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.66
passages.text: Aspice, aratra iugo referunt suspensa iuvenci,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.67
passages.text: et sol crescentis decedens duplicat umbras:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.68
passages.text: me tamen urit amor; quis enim modus adsit amori?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.69
passages.text: Ah, Corydon, Corydon, quae te dementia cepit!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.70
passages.text: Semiputata tibi frondosa vitis in ulmo est;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.71
passages.text: quin tu aliquid saltem potius, quorum indiget usus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.72
passages.text: viminibus mollique paras detexere iunco?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 2.73
passages.text: Invenies alium, si te hic fastidit, Alexim.
